title: ACE-M3: Automatic Capability Evaluator for Multimodal Medical Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the differences in the evaluation model's accuracy when the better response is placed in the first versus the second position.
Comparing the evaluation model's accuracy when the better response is longer versus when it is shorter to measure preference for response length.
Swapping the positions of the two responses and measuring the percentage of samples where the evaluation model's results change.
